title: Meetings
description: Send an agent into a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting as a named participant.
info: Meetings run through your own Attendee account: Attendee puts a bot in the meeting and streams its audio to your agent here. Attendee bills you for bot hours; the conversation counts as a call from the moment the bot is let in.
loadFailed: Could not load your meeting settings.

attendee.heading: Connect Attendee
attendee.signUpLine: Sign up at <link>app.attendee.dev</link> or run your own install, create an API key in your Attendee project, and paste it here.
attendee.byoLine: Attendee is the meeting-bot service behind this page. Its Elastic License does not let {appName} run it for you, so you bring your own account.
attendee.connectedLine: Connected to <mono>{url}</mono> with the key ending in {last4}.
attendee.hostedLine: Uses <mono>{url}</mono>. Attendee bills you for bot hours.
attendee.selfLine: Your own Attendee install. Enter its address below.
attendee.baseUrlHint: The https address of your Attendee install.
attendee.apiKeyHint: From the API keys of your Attendee project. Checked with Attendee, then encrypted; it is never shown again.
attendee.apiKeyNewUrlHint: A new Attendee address needs its own API key.
attendee.keyEnding: Key ending in {last4}. Leave blank to keep it.
attendee.webhookSecretHint: From Settings → Webhooks in your Attendee project, in base64. When set, every status update Attendee sends is signature-checked.
attendee.webhookSecretPlaceholder: Paste the secret as Attendee shows it
attendee.webhookSecretSaved: Saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
attendee.webhookSecretClearing: The saved secret is removed when you save.
attendee.signedInBotsLine: The bot signs into an account before joining, so the meeting shows a named participant instead of a guest that Google Meet flags as a bot. Set the account up in Attendee first, under Settings → Bot Logins.
attendee.meetHint: Needs a Google Workspace account for the bot.
attendee.teamsHint: Needs a Microsoft 365 account for the bot.
attendee.loginGroupHint: The Bot Logins group in Attendee to sign in with.
attendee.zoomNote: For Zoom, your Attendee project also needs a Zoom Meeting SDK app. Signed-in bots are not available for Zoom.
attendee.disconnectDescription: The saved API key and webhook secret are deleted here. Meetings in progress finish as they are; new ones cannot be sent until you connect again.

send.heading: Send an agent to a meeting
send.description: The agent joins as a participant and talks the way it does on a call.
send.noAgents: Create an agent first, then send it to a meeting.
send.meetingUrlHint: An https Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams join link.
send.meetingUrlInvalid: Paste a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams link that starts with https://.
send.botNameHint: What the participant list shows. Defaults to the agent's name.
send.addressedLine: Only after someone says its name, and for a moment after it last spoke.
send.alwaysLine: Answers whatever it hears. Best for a one-to-one meeting.
send.wakeNamesHint: Extra names people may call it by, separated by commas, up to {max}. Its own name always works.
send.wakeNamesTooShort: Each wake name needs 2 to 60 characters.
send.maxDurationHint: The bot leaves after this many minutes, {min} to {max}.

toast.sent: {name} is on its way into the meeting.

recent.heading: Recent meetings
recent.description: The last {count} meetings. Live rows refresh on their own.
recent.emptyDescription: Meetings your agents join appear here, with how they went.
recent.emptyNotConnected: Connect Attendee above, then send an agent to its first meeting.

reason.bot_not_created: Attendee did not create the bot

recent.leaveDescription: The bot leaves now. One still joining or waiting to be let in is called off.
recent.leaveFailed: Could not make the agent leave.

errors.missing_api_key: Paste an API key from your Attendee project.
errors.unsafe_attendee_url: That Attendee address cannot be used. Enter the public https address of your install.
errors.attendee_key_rejected: Attendee did not accept that API key. Check it in your Attendee project and try again.
errors.invalid_webhook_secret: That is not an Attendee webhook secret. Paste it as Attendee shows it, in base64.
errors.feature_not_in_plan: Meetings are not included in your plan. Upgrade to send agents to meetings.
errors.unsupported_meeting_url: Use an https Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting link.
errors.missing_keys: {missing} is not configured. Add it in Settings before sending this agent to a meeting.
errors.signed_in_not_supported: Signed-in bots work on Google Meet and Teams, not Zoom.
errors.attendee_refused: Attendee refused to create the bot. Check your Attendee project and try again.
